verdict.rationale: mParticle's docs list a 'Real-time API to drive user personalization' and a 'complete view of your users' feature, and IDSync is described as creating a unified view of customers, which points to its own profile-query capability. The evidence consists mostly of section titles, with no documented endpoints, schema, or query semantics. missing for 10: documented profile API endpoints and query methods, explicit retrieval of traits, identifiers and event history per profile, a profile store or warehouse query option, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can query unified customer profiles — traits, identifiers, event history — through a documented profile API or store

citations.quote: Real-time API to drive user personalization
Get a complete view of your users
IDSync is mParticle's identity resolution framework, enabling you to create a unified view of your customers
